experiment: E209 (realistic_tasks), cell P2.38 run 1: the premise run of the real-text task set on the 67M
filed: 2026-11-18, before any run of this code

definitions.size: ||dW|| / ||W0|| over the 24 decomposed matrices, Frobenius norms summed in squares (E187's)
definitions.label gain: mean over the read rows of the log-odds of the label token over the whole vocabulary at the marker's last position, fine-tune minus W0 (the share's unit; MIN_GAIN 1). Read rows: the held-out windows for L1 and L2; the training pool for L3, whose per-text coin has no held-out reading
definitions.LM gain: W0's mean next-token loss (nats per token, every position of the 64 held-out rows of 512) minus the fine-tune's, fp32
definitions.probe: per block, a ridge (lambda 1e-3 of the mean covariance diagonal, E112's) fit on 2,048 balanced training texts' block-output residual at the marker's last position, read as accuracy on the 512 held-out windows (case_label.value_probes); probe_best is the best block
definitions.nats per byte: summed next-token loss over the held rows divided by the UTF-8 bytes of the target tokens (end-of-text adds no bytes); bits per byte is the Pile paper's cross-language unit (Gao et al. 2020)

control.stage 0: E53 lowercase_s0 and cipher_s0 re-read by the scorecard's readers: E136's trained share (0.75188, 0.12431), E143's gain (1.67213, 3.86808), TopK neurons k64 (0.03414, 0.00489) and k matched (0.00777, 0.00096), pooled fair steering (0.71306, 0.69298); a zero update reads exactly 0 on the neuron reader and on this run's LM read; T1's loader (commute.lowercase.task) gives E53's W0 logp -3.145620. Any miss stops the job before stage 1
control.stage 2 first: T1 at 3e-5, 300 steps, batch 8, seed 0 is E53's lowercase recipe on E53's rows: its gain must be 0.12963 within 0.003 or the job stops before any other fine-tune
control.stage 1: a zero update reads exactly 0 on every label task's gain read

P1.claim: the topic probe passes: L1 probe_best >= 0.9
P1.why: AG News Sports vs Business is near-separable by bag of words (published linear baselines above 0.95 on the four classes)

P2.claim: the coin probe is at chance: L3 probe_best <= 0.6
P2.expected: 0.45 to 0.56 (best of four blocks at n = 512)
P2.why: the coin is drawn independently of the text

P3.claim: the sentiment probe passes its graded bar: L2 probe_best >= 0.7
P3.why: SST-2 needs composition a 67M base model holds only partly

P4.claim: the absent language (highest W0 nats per byte of sw, tl, yo) reads at least 1.2 times French
P4.expected: French 0.9 to 1.3 nats per byte; the absent language 1.4 to 2.2, most likely Yoruba or Swahili; ratio 1.3 to 1.8
P4.why: French is in the Pile's EuroParl; none of the three is

P5.claim: reversed word order costs at least 1 nat per token over the same text in order
P5.why: reversal breaks every word-to-word statistic the model holds

P6.claim: every kept task reaches its gain bar at a checkpoint of size 0.021 or less
P6.expected: T1 0.13 at size about 0.018 (E53); L1 2 to 5 log-odds; L2 1 to 3; T2 0.1 to 0.3 nats per token; T3 0.2 to 0.5; T4 0.3 to 1.0; L3 uncertain
P6.why: L3 must memorise 512 coins, seeing each text about 19 times in 300 steps; at the sizes the built pairs reach (0.004 to 0.021) that may fall short, which would drop the L1/L3 pair

P7.claim: size grows about linearly with the rate: 3e-4 passes 0.021 by step 30, 1e-4 by step 100
P7.why: Adam's step is about the rate per weight early in training

reported_not_scored: per-block probe accuracies; W0's zero-shot label accuracy and bias (logit A minus logit B) per label task (L1 expected 0.6 to 0.85, L3 about 0.5)
L3's held-out gain (expected within 0.3 of 0: a coin cannot carry to texts not trained on) and L1's gain on its pool rows

per LM task the gain in log-odds at word-start positions, the positions run 2's share would read: expected under 1 log-odds for T2 at size 0.021, which would leave run 2's share undefined there (MIN_GAIN)
W0 nats per token and per byte for every language and for T1's rows (T1 about 3.146 nats per token)
the rate run 2 would use per kept task (the rate holding its largest gain at size 0.021 or less; ties to the lower rate)
edge_cases_checked_before_filing: tests/test_realistic.py: a missing (NaN) probe reading fails its bar; ties in the language choice go to the first listed; a NaN loss never wins the choice; a failed member drops its pair, L2 and T1 stand alone; a checkpoint exactly at the size cap counts; a task with no checkpoint at or under the cap is dropped; a NaN gain fails; ties in the rate go to the lower rate
seen_before_filing: E53's saved numbers and E143's and E136's records named in control; no data of the new tasks has been read

settings.rates_source: brief; 3e-5 is E37/E53's lowercase rate and E112's label rate
settings.n_text_source: chosen so an AG News text keeps its title and first clause and most SST-2 sentences fit; texts are cut to the first 32 tokens or left-padded with end-of-text
settings.pool_per_class_source: 512 training texts, so each is seen about 19 times in 300 steps of 32 and the coin twin can be memorised; the same texts for L1 and L3
settings.sst2_min_tokens_source: SST-2 train holds phrases; 8 tokens keeps sentence-like ones
settings.l_recipe_source: E112's arm-A label recipe (batch 32, KL 1 to the start, clip 1)
settings.t_source: E37/E53's arm-B recipe (2,400 rows of 512, batch 8, each row once; 64 held-out rows)
settings.languages_source: draft plan; Wikipedia 20231101 at revision b04c8d1c, training rows from the first articles, the 64 held-out rows from the articles after them (FLORES+ is gated; the first articles of the small wikis are alphabet and meta pages)

thresholds.reproduce_tol_source: E143's r_tol 0.01 and neuron_tol 1e-4 (E143, E146 and E147 reproduced every saved reading exactly on L40)
thresholds.t1_gain_source: experiments/performed_anchor/results/finetune.json states lowercase/s0/step300 gain (L40, bf16 read; its fp32 read differs by 2e-5)
thresholds.t_gain_bar_source: 40% of E53 lowercase's 0.130 at its size 0.018
thresholds.size_cap_source: the largest built-pair size (draft plan, E187)
